title: Folate pathway: PAS, dfrA, thyA
dek: PAS is old, ugly, and a folate-pathway drug. Resistance genetics (thyA, folC, dfrA, ribD) are real salvage genomics. INH also nicks folate indirectly; do not fuse the plates.
story: Para-aminosalicylic acid is a sulfonamide-adjacent antimetabolite from the pre-rifampin era. It poisons folate/thymidylate metabolism (FolC, dihydrofolate pathways) and is still a Group C salvage drug when Group A/B are exhausted. It is not a BPaLM ingredient and it is not first-line.

Resistance: thyA (thymidylate synthase) loss-of-function, folC missense, dfrA (dihydrofolate reductase) changes, and ribD overexpression stories appear in catalogues with uneven confidence. This is a pncA-like scatter plus metabolic bypass, not an RRDR.
INH has a side-conversation with folate (NAD adducts, ndh) that is not PAS resistance. Keep the genes on their plates. Do not bulk-copy Mycobrowser folate annotations into a PAS column.
deep: Longer individualised regimens when BDQ/LZD/Pa/FQ are gone. GI intolerance and hypothyroidism (especially with ETH) are the host taxes.
PAS-sodium vs PAS acid formulations change PK; follow the handbook if you actually use it.
dfrA is essential-ish; some “resistance” alleles are MIC nudges. MIC if you have it.
Sulfonamides/cotrimoxazole are not PAS, though folate is the shared neighbourhood — HIV prophylaxis is not TB salvage.

visual.caption: PAS enters folate/thymidylate metabolism. thyA/folC/dfrA are the genomic handles. This is salvage biochemistry, not a first-line map.

example.title: thyA frameshift, last-line construction
example.setup: XDR 2021, BPaL failed, FQ-R, BDQ efflux, LZD rplC. Someone adds PAS. WGS: thyA frameshift.

steps.title: PAS is genetically compromised
steps.body: thyA LOF is a recognised PAS path. Do not count it as a full Group C drug without MIC humility.

steps.title: You are in true salvage
steps.body: Carbapenems+clavulanate, linezolid if any residual, surgery, trials — not another historical oral for theatre.

steps.title: Do not also blame INH genes

example.takeaway: Folate-pathway salvage has genetics. Use them, then admit when the cupboard is empty.
